Gaps and implications

Your journey today: a huge, loyal audience, and no free live step between a listen and a purchase

1

Without a masterclass, there is no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren’t ready for your high-ticket offer yet.

2

And there is no way to find out who in your audience is actually qualified for it.

*95% is an industry estimate, not your data.

Live teaching

Your best moments are behind a paywall

Every month you teach live (11 November is “Taking the Lead as a Highly Sensitive Person”), and on Crowdcast it’s marked Patreon only. The people who don’t know you well yet never get to experience you live before they buy.

Courses

The library waits for one moment a year

The Boundaries Intensive opens each fall. The rest of the year Intro to Boundaries, 30 Days to Peace and the others sit on your courses page with nothing walking a listener towards them.

High ticket

No way to spot who wants deeper support

Emotional Strength Training is invite-only and 1:1 is waitlisted, with no application in between. In an audience this size, the people ready for more are there, but you can’t see who they are.

Millions of people already listen to you. There’s no free hour yet where they can learn with you live and take the next step.

My recommendation

A free masterclass on boundaries, with Intro to Boundaries on the thank-you page

You already have low-ticket products, so the masterclass itself should be free. It’s education and coaching, not therapy: one hour on boundaries for highly sensitive people, in the voice your listeners already know. Intro to Boundaries earns from day one and pays for the ads, and the replay page invites the right people to apply for Emotional Strength Training.

Monetises the 95%

A free hour with you is the easiest yes there is. Everyone who registers sees Intro to Boundaries on the thank-you page, at the moment they’re most curious, and that revenue covers the ad spend.

Shows you who’s qualified

The people who stay to the end and apply from the replay page are raising their hand. A short application tells you who wants Emotional Strength Training before anyone gets on a call.

A year-round front door

Every sign-up joins your list, so when the Boundaries Intensive opens next fall you launch to thousands of new people who have already learned with you live.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready for more yet

They join the free masterclass, many add Intro to Boundaries, and some join Patreon or wait for the Intensive. The podcast and your emails keep them close until they’re ready.

The qualified 5%

Ready for deeper support now

They stay to the end and apply from the replay page. A few questions (what they want help with, timing, readiness to invest) sort them before a short call about Emotional Strength Training.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Free masterclass with Nikki Eisenhauer

The boundary nobody taught you

A free 60-minute masterclass for highly sensitive people, with Nikki Eisenhauer, M.Ed., LPC, host of the Emotional Badass podcast. Why boundaries feel so hard when you feel everything deeply, and simple scripts and soul care practices to start setting them, kindly and clearly.

Live online60 minutesReplay includedFree

Who it’s for

For the deep feelers and the reluctant boundary-setters

  • You want to say no without replaying it for days afterwards.
  • You’re the one everyone leans on, and you’d like some energy left for yourself.
  • Conflict feels huge, so you keep the peace even when something matters to you.
  • You want words you can actually use this week, not just theory.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in one hour

Why boundaries feel so hard for sensitive people

What feeling everything deeply has to do with people-pleasing, and why “just say no” advice rarely sticks.

The boundary nobody taught you

Most advice starts with what to say. This one starts earlier, with what you let in.

The guilt loop

Why guilt so often shows up right after a no, and what to do with it instead of backing down.

A simple script for saying no

A short, customisable script you can use at work, with family and in relationships, kindly and clearly.

Soul care that holds the line

Small daily practices that help you keep the boundaries you set, without burning out to do it.

Meet your host

Hi, I’m Nikki

I’m a Licensed Professional Counselor, psychotherapist, international life coach and yoga teacher. Since 2018 I’ve hosted Emotional Badass: Where Moxie Meets Mindful, the mental health podcast for seekers, dreamers and badasses, and my boundaries course, now in its eighth year, runs live every fall.

Emotional Badass is where we learn to love ourselves without apology. This masterclass is my way of sharing what I teach, for free, with anyone who wants to learn.
